Name: nastapolka's New Game Plus
Author: nastapolka
Description:
[size=4]The other New Game Plus mod.
Lets you start a new game while inheriting a number of things from another save file.[/size]

[size=5][b][u]How to use
[/u][/b][/size][size=4] ﻿1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI [/url]and this mod.
﻿2. If you want to bring over items, make sure they are in your old character's inventory, then save.
﻿ ﻿You'll probably want to be carrying all your tools (pickaxe, hoe, axe, scythe, and watering can).
[/size][size=4] ﻿3. Create a new character. Click on the NG+ icon on the left of the character customization menu
﻿ ﻿to bring up the options.
[/size][size=4] ﻿4. Select the save file you want to inherit from.[/size][size=4]
﻿5. Check the items you want to bring over to your new save, and uncheck the ones you don't want.[/size][size=4]
﻿6. Start a new game.[/size][size=5][u]

What you can inherit[/u][/size]
﻿[size=4]1. [b]Character appearance[/b][/size][size=4][b] ﻿[/b]
﻿ ﻿- (default: on)
﻿ ﻿- This copies the character's name, farm name, favourite thing, pet preference, skin colour, etc
﻿ ﻿over to the character creation menu.
﻿ ﻿- You can then edit these settings and the new game will start with the edited settings.

﻿2. [b]Unique ID[/b]
﻿ ﻿- ﻿﻿(default: off)
﻿ ﻿- This copies the "Random Seed" from the selected save to the advanced options in character creation.

﻿3. [b]Money[/b] [b] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[/b]
﻿ ﻿- ﻿[size=4]﻿(default: on)
[/size]
﻿4. [b]Max stamina[/b]
﻿ ﻿- (default: on)

﻿5. [b]Skills and professions[/b]
﻿ ﻿- ﻿(default: on)
﻿ ﻿- Inherit the vanilla skill levels (including Luck) and ALL professions.
﻿ ﻿- If you have a modded skill, this may cause you to inherit only the professions for that skill,
﻿ ﻿ ﻿but not the skill levels...

﻿6. [b]Masteries and trinkets[/b]
﻿ ﻿- (default: on)
﻿ ﻿- Inherit mastery exp, mastery levels, masteries, number of trinket slots, and equipped trinkets.
﻿ ﻿- Turning this on will automatically enable Cooking and Crafting Recipe inheritance.

﻿ ﻿7. [b]Inventory, inventory size, and trash can upgrades﻿[/b]
﻿ ﻿- (default: on)
﻿ ﻿- As mentioned above, turning this on OVERWRITES the new character's inventory and all the items in it
﻿ ﻿ ﻿(watering can and stuff).
﻿ ﻿- Make sure to have those tools in your old character's inventory!

﻿8. [b]Cooking and crafting recipes[/b][size=4]
﻿ ﻿- ﻿[size=4](default: on)
﻿ ﻿- Inherit all learned recipes and also how many times each have been crafted/cooked.
﻿ ﻿- Note: the recipe book will be marked as unread so it can be read again, even if
﻿ ﻿ ﻿all its recipes have been learned.
﻿ ﻿- This is in case more recipes are added to it in the future.

﻿9. [b]Equipment (rings and stuff) currently equipped[/b]
﻿ ﻿- (default: on)
﻿ ﻿- Does not include trinkets! See Masteries and Trinkets above for that option.

[size=4] ﻿10. [b]Power books read[/b][size=4]
﻿ ﻿- ﻿[size=4](default: on)
[/size][/size][/size] ﻿ ﻿- Does not include the recipe book, because that's not a power book.
[/size][/size]
﻿11. [b]Collections and museum contributions[/b][size=4]
﻿ ﻿- ﻿[size=4](default: on)
﻿ ﻿- Includes shipped items, artifacts/minerals found and contributed to the museum, ﻿and fish caught.
﻿ ﻿- Does NOT include number of times each recipe is cooked. (See [size=4][b]Cooking and crafting recipes[/b][/size])
[/size][/size] ﻿ ﻿Sub option: [b]Cleanup museum
[/b] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿- (default: off)[b]
[/b] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿- Check this option if the old save used mods that introduced more artifacts, but you're no longer using
﻿ ﻿ ﻿those mods in your current runs, resulting in error items in the museum.
﻿ ﻿Sub option: [b]Rearrange museum[/b]
[size=4] ﻿ ﻿- (default: off)[/size]
﻿ ﻿ ﻿- Makes the game put every artifact into a valid spot in the museum.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿- Warning: if you somehow have more artifacts than spaces in the museum, some artifacts will be lost.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿﻿- Check this option only if the above option removed artifacts, but results in empty spaces on the tables and
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿artifacts on the floor.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿
﻿12. [b]Friendships[/b][size=4]
﻿ ﻿- ﻿[size=4](default: on)
﻿ ﻿- Only inherits friendship points. Spouse/roommate statuses not inherited.
[/size][/size]
﻿13. [b]Currencies[/b][size=4]
﻿ ﻿- ﻿[size=4](default: on)
﻿ ﻿- Qi gems, walnuts, and casino coins.

﻿14. [b]Monster kills[/b]
﻿ ﻿- (default: on)
[/size][/size]

[/size][size=5][b][u]What you cannot inherit[/u][/b][/size][size=4] (and a bunch of excuses)
﻿1. Spouse/roommate status
[size=4] ﻿2. House upgrades and interior[/size]
﻿3. Farm and buildings on it
﻿4. Max health
﻿5. Special items and powers other than power books

(1) and (2) are not implement these because I wasn't sure if spouses would bug out
when they can't find their room because the house wasn't inherited, and
vice versa.
[size=4]Silver lining: you'll get to propose to your spouse all over again.[/size]
(3) Not sure how this would work with the pet and horse.
Also, if everything gets inherited the player might not have anything left to do...
(4) Max health gets recalculated based on skill level, so there's no point raising the value itself.
(5) Probably not a good idea to touch quest flags and stuff.

[/size][size=5]
[b][u]Caveats[/u][/b][/size][size=4]
1. If you inherit inventory but don't have all the tools on your old character,
﻿you won't have access to those on the first day.
﻿- This is because the old inventory overwrites the starting items.
﻿- You'll have to wait a day to get a replacement from the Lost & Found box in the mayor's house.
﻿- This replacement will not have any upgrades.
﻿- Yes this is the third time you're reading this.
2. When pressing the NG+ button, the game will lag because it reads every single save.
﻿- It shouldn't lag anymore unless you return to title and then go back to character creation.


[/size]
